tasks.task: I’m planning time off and need to avoid any meetings. For Mia Lee (mia.lee1@example.com), check whether she has any calendar events on 2025-01-01 (New Year’s Day). Also confirm that 2025-01-01 is a listed holiday. I need the answer today so I can finalize my PTO request.

success_criteria: Step 1 returns the user object for Mia Lee with email mia.lee1@example.com (u-001).
Step 2 returns at least one holiday on 2025-01-01, including an item titled "New Year's Day" (event_id h-1).
Step 3 returns a list of events for Mia on 2025-01-01; the final answer clearly states whether the count is zero or non-zero.

tasks.task: I need to schedule a 30-minute 1:1 with Mia Lee (mia.lee1@example.com) on 2025-03-10, but it must not conflict with any meetings she’s already attending that day. Please check her calendar for that date and also confirm whether there are any holidays that day before proposing the earliest available time slot.

success_criteria: The user lookup returns the user object for Mia Lee with email mia.lee1@example.com.
The events list for Mia on 2025-03-10 is returned (may be empty) and can be used to determine whether any 30-minute slot conflicts exist.
The holiday query for 2025-03-10 returns the set of holidays on that date (empty if none), allowing confirmation of holiday constraints.

tasks.task: I’m coordinating with Mia Lee (mia.lee1@example.com) and need to know whether she has any meetings on 2025-01-26, because she is only eligible to attend the remote “Estimation Meeting” that day if she has no other calendar conflicts. Please check her events for that date, and then pull up the full details of the “Estimation Meeting” (event e-005) so I can confirm timing and location before I invite her.

success_criteria: Step 1 returns a valid user object for Mia Lee with email mia.lee1@example.com.
Step 2 returns the complete list (possibly empty) of events Mia Lee attends on 2025-01-26, allowing a definitive conflict-free vs. conflicting determination.
Step 3 returns event e-005 and includes its title, start_time, end_time, and location so timing/location can be confirmed against Mia’s availability.
